title: Chromatic Gold Chevaliere - Crimson Forest Boss Guide
description: The Chromatic Gold Chevaliere in Expedition 33's Crimson Forest: weak to Light and Dark, resists Fire and Ice. Location, weakness and strategy.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Chromatic Gold Chevaliere (sometimes searched for as the golden knight) is an optional Chromatic boss found in the Crimson Forest. It is one of three Chevaliere variants, alongside the Ceramic and Steel versions.

sections.title: Where to Find It
sections.content:
Location: Crimson Forest. It is an optional Act 3 encounter on The Continent.

The non-Chromatic Gold Chevaliere also appears as a regular enemy in several locations on The Continent with the same elemental profile.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toLight, Dark
ResistsFire, Ice

A neat pairing: Light and Dark both work, Fire and Ice are both resisted. Bring either Light or Dark damage and avoid the two resisted elements.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.content:
Because the resistances are symmetrical and simple, this is a straightforward elemental check rather than a mechanics puzzle.

  • Change your weapon's element before the fight - if your equipped weapon deals Fire or Ice, you are fighting it at a severe disadvantage
  • Chromatic bosses are tuned harder than their base versions and drop Resplendent and Grandiose Chroma Catalysts along with weapons, Pictos and Colours of Lumina, so they are worth doing for progression materials

Worth knowing: Chromatic enemies are described in-game as more complex and difficult versions of basic enemies - the Chevaliere family is a good example, where the Steel variant is weak to Physical while the Gold variant is weak to Light and Dark.
